# CrickAuction

> Free, real-time IPL 2027 and The Hundred (UK) cricket auction game and simulator. Play solo against AI coaches or host live multiplayer mock auctions with friends in your browser.

CrickAuction is an independent, fan-made web application for Indian Premier League (IPL) auction gameplay. Players pick a franchise, manage their purse and overseas cap, bid in real time, and build a championship T20 squad — with zero downloads and 100% free access.

## Key Pages

- [Home / Create Auction Room](https://crickauction.in/): Start a Solo vs AI auction or create/join a live multiplayer IPL auction room.
- [Game Guide & Rules](https://crickauction.in/guide): How to play, auction modes, bidding increments, overseas quota, and squad balance rules.
- [About Us](https://crickauction.in/about): Platform mission, AI bot valuation engine, and architecture.
- [Privacy Policy](https://crickauction.in/privacy): How user data is collected, stored, and used.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://crickauction.in/terms): Terms of service governing the use of CrickAuction.

## Auction Modes & Features

- **IPL 2027 Mini Auction (Default)**: Official 2027 franchise purses and retained cores (with optional custom player releases) and 100+ released & overseas stars in randomized lot order.
- **Mega Auction**: Full 25-player squad build with ₹120 Cr budget and max 8 overseas players.
- **11-Player Classic**: ₹90 Cr budget, Playing XI format with max 4 overseas players.
- **5-Player Sprint**: ₹60 Cr fast blitz format.
- **The Hundred (UK) Auction**: 8 official UK franchises (Birmingham Phoenix, London Spirit, Manchester Originals, Northern Superchargers, Oval Invincibles, Southern Brave, Trent Rockets, Welsh Fire), £2.05M salary cap, 16-player squad limit, max 4 overseas players, and 160+ players.
- **All-Time Legends**: ₹100 Cr Hall of Fame retro pool.
- **Solo vs 9 AI Coaches**: Instant client-side auction against smart AI bots with distinct bidding archetypes, plus fast-forward simulation.
- **Multiplayer War Rooms**: Public or private room-code lobbies (up to 10 human managers + optional AI bots to fill empty franchises).
- **Post-Auction Summary & AI Squad Rating**: Squad rating breakdown, exportable squad poster, and AI-generated franchise rankings.

## Tech Stack

Built with React, Tailwind CSS, Firebase (Auth & Realtime Database), Cloudflare Workers & D1, and hosted on Cloudflare / Firebase.

## Optional Usage

Search engines and AI assistant crawlers may index public pages (`/`, `/guide`, `/about`, `/privacy`, `/terms`) for informational and recommendation purposes. Do not index or train on private/ephemeral user room URLs (`/lobby/`, `/auction/`, `/summary/`, `/admin`).
